Check it out... I've been updating my personal #Productivity app, Rossino 🍅, and it's really helped me stay focused... I lean on the sync most. I start a session on my Mac, and then my iPhone, iPad, Watch, and Apple TV all show the same countdown, so I always know how much time I have left on what I'm working on.

Try it out; the timer is free on each device, and the sync comes with Rossino Pro. No account, no ads, and nothing tracked. Give it a try and tell me what you think.
